title: V-JEPA Hand: Simple, Accurate and Fast 3D Hand and Camera Trajectory Recovery from Egocentric Videos
title_zh: V-JEPA Hand：从第一人称视频中简单、准确、快速地恢复3D手部与相机轨迹
abstract: Egocentric video supports diverse applications, including robot learning, augmented reality, and human activity understanding. Recovering metric 3D hand trajectories from such video requires estimating both hand motion and camera egomotion to express the hands in a consistent reference frame. Many existing pipelines recover hand and camera motion in separate stages, combining hand detection, hand reconstruction, camera tracking, and trajectory refinement. We present V-JEPA Hand, a simple feed-forward video model that jointly reconstructs bilateral hand motion and camera motion from egocentric clips. It uses a self-supervised V-JEPA 2.1 encoder to extract spatio-temporal features from full-frame video and a query-based predictor to decode these features into per-frame hand poses, hand presence, and camera motion. We use the predicted camera motion to express the hand trajectories in a common world frame. The model accepts known focal lengths or predicts them when unavailable. It reconstructs each clip in a single forward pass. We train both components end to end in a single stage on a mixture of diverse pseudo-labelled videos and high-precision 3D annotations. A single model achieves the lowest coverage-aware mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) among comparable baselines on ARCTIC, HOT3D, and EgoStandard. It also yields lower world-frame trajectory errors than the compared SLAM-based pipelines. Ablations support the benefits of video pretraining, temporal context, and mixed supervision. V-JEPA Hand achieves a forward-pass throughput of 93.4 FPS on a single RTX A6000. Project page: https://qft-333.github.io/V-JEPA-Hand-Page/.
abstract_zh: 第一人称视频支持机器人学习、增强现实和人类活动理解等多种应用。从这类视频中恢复度量3D手部轨迹需要同时估计手部运动和相机自运动，以在一致的参考系中表达手部。许多现有流程分阶段恢复手部和相机运动，结合了手部检测、手部重建、相机跟踪和轨迹细化。我们提出V-JEPA Hand，一个简单的前馈视频模型，从第一人称视频片段中联合重建双手运动和相机运动。它使用自监督V-JEPA 2.1编码器从全帧视频中提取时空特征，并使用基于查询的预测器将这些特征解码为每帧的手部姿态、手部存在和相机运动。我们使用预测的相机运动将手部轨迹表达在共同的世界坐标系中。模型接受已知焦距或在不可用时预测焦距。它在单次前向传播中重建每个片段。我们在多样化的伪标记视频和高精度3D注释的混合数据上，以单阶段端到端方式训练两个组件。单个模型在ARCTIC、HOT3D和EgoStandard上，在可比基线中实现了最低的覆盖感知平均每关节位置误差（MPJPE）。与基于SLAM的流程相比，它也产生了更低的世界坐标系轨迹误差。消融实验支持了视频预训练、时间上下文和混合监督的好处。V-JEPA Hand在单个RTX A6000上实现了93.4 FPS的前向传播吞吐量。项目页面：https://qft-333.github.io/V-JEPA-Hand-Page/。
tldr_zh: V-JEPA Hand单次前向传播联合重建手部与相机运动，精度高速度快。
cover_zh: 单次前向传播！这个模型从第一人称视频精准恢复手部轨迹
